notes.title: Hotfix and April Graphics Beta
notes.content:
-Hotfix to resolve reported bug

-New Graphics mode "Cyclops Mode", available for our beginning of the next month's graphical update testing. Designed by an illegal Deep Learning AI I got off the NASA Darkweb, it is the most advanced visual experience possible without quantum computing. Access it via the game IO options (the map scroll/key bindings... opts in the bottom right of the screen).

notes.title: Beta Branch: Ultra-wide Hotfix
notes.content:
-Provisional support (only black bars, sadly) for ultra-wide monitors

-Changed voting slightly. No crisis for Dark Empire agent actions or enshadowed nobles, reduced some vote spam

notes.title: Beta Branch New Agent: The Saviour
notes.content:
Added in a new agent for initial testing. Mostly done, might change some stuff for balance, bugfixing or general improvement before it hits the actual main branch.

The agent is `The Saviour'. General concept is that you threaten a nation with either war or disease, then The Saviour `rescues' them, either by defeating the enemy or curing the disease. The nobles then love the saviour, and you can exploit this to either infiltrate better, influence politics via trading liking for votes, or boost the prestige of your political enthralled noble.

notes.title: Beta Branch: Winter's Scythe Update
notes.content:
Based on discussion with community member fishchisel, I've taken a look at Winter's Scythe, and buffed the cold Dark Name somewhat.

-Buffs to most abilities
-Added a catastrophic power which requires you to have already frozen some of the world. Once you've reached a certain point, you can constantly make it colder. The NPCs' only hope at that point is the Lightbringer Ritual.
-Added an ability called 'Blizzard', which allows you to break location-location links, preventing units from travelling between them (amongst other effects). Only works in snowy areas, so you'll have regions of the map where your agents can benefit from weather-based assistance

notes.title: BetaBranch update
notes.content:
-Added zoom-to capability on event and threat messages in the right-hand sidebar. Did I hack something together because I couldn't figure out how to get Unity's hitscan UI thingy to work and so instead just replaced everything with buttons? Yes I did.

Still needs wars to have the same capability, probably, and people want flags to be displayed in messages, so let's see what's possible.

notes.title: Version 17: Agent Select Resolution Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed Resolution issue, which was causing the agent select dialog to scale incorrectly (the previous dialog was still around when it was created, causing it to get confused and upset and not detect the screen resolution properly)
